384:t_022:7.en:
$n
「I'll beat you and get Miss $$スズネ$$ back!」

384:t_022:11.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「It was worth coming all this way.」

384:t_022:12.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「$n... Next time, I'll bring $$西条涼音$$, just as you want.」

384:t_022:13.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Though I won't guarantee what condition she'll be in.」

384:t_022:17.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You've served me well up to today.」

384:t_022:19.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Here's your reward. I'll unleash the hatred inside you.」

384:t_023:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「What is he going to do!?」

384:t_023:1.en:
$$ロラン$$
「He said he'd unleash his hatred, but...」

384:t_023:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That aura coming from $$ギルター$$...!」

384:t_023:7.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I-I am $$ギルター・ベローネ$$! Anyone who insults me can die!!」

384:t_023:8.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「What fine hatred, $$ギルター$$. Keeping you as a pet was worthwhile.」

384:t_023:9.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Putting you, a mass of inferiority and jealousy, under $$サルディアス$$ was the perfect way to raise you.」

384:t_023:10.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$バルビエル$$! You amplified your subordinate $$ギルター$$'s hatred and destroyed his mind!」

384:t_023:11.en:
$$クロウ$$
「That bastard...! He did it again!?」

384:t_023:12.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I'll leave the rest to you, $$ギルター$$. ...Though even if you defeat $c, there's no future for you.」

384:t_023:14.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Don't get carried away, $n. Your awakening is still unstable.」

384:t_023:15.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「The slightest trigger could make the backlash kill your mind... Can you endure that?」

384:t_023:17.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I look forward to seeing you again, $c! Next time, I'll invite your beloved Miss $$スズネ$$ too!」

384:t_025:2.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「I came to confirm that the powers governing the $$オリジン・ロー$$ are gathering, but I saw something interesting...」

384:t_025:3.en:
$$タケル$$
「Are you talking about the $$スフィア$$s!?」

384:t_025:4.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「Not just those, $$マーズ$$...! I cannot stand by and let your power awaken any further!」

384:t_025:5.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「This is a good opportunity. I'll dispose of you here!」

384:t_025:7.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「Heh heh... Someone here has been nicely swallowed by the darkness too.」

384:t_025:9.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「As incomplete as you are now, you couldn't even defeat that man! Farewell, $$マーズ$$!」

384:t_026:0.en:
$$タケル$$
(Darkness... Is he talking about my brother's power...?)

384:t_026:1.en:
$$タケル$$
(If so, what will happen to me now that I've taken it in...?)

384:t_026:2.en:
$n
「Let's do this, $$タケル$$...! He's not the $$ギルター$$ we knew!」

384:t_026:4.en:
$$葵$$
「So basically, he's a berserker ruled by hatred! We can't lose to someone like that!」

384:t_026:5.en:
$$シモン$$
「We'll finish off $$ギルター$$ and the army of darkness together!」

384:t_026:6.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「All units, begin the attack! Our target is $$ギルター・ベローネ$$!」

384:t_027:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I-I am $$ギルター・ベローネ$$! $$サイデリアル$$'s greatest strategist and general, a man worthy of being $$アンタレス$$' deputy commander!」

384:t_027:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
「All you ignorant fools, bow before me! $$サルディアス$$, $$バルビエル$$, even Emperor $$アウストラリス$$!」

384:t_028:0.en:
$$セツコ$$
「You... are such a sad person...」

384:t_028:3.en:
$$タケル$$
「Did he break free of $$バルビエル$$'s control in the face of death...?」

384:t_028:4.en:
$$ギルター$$
「N-no...! I don't want to die! I...!」

384:t_029:0.en:
$$田中司令$$
「...It appears to be over.」

384:t_029:1.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「The venom $$ギルター$$ spread seems to have been short-lived. The residents' confusion is subsiding too.」

384:t_029:2.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「The soldiers remaining in the $$ターミナル・ベース$$ also appear to have withdrawn.」

384:t_029:3.en:
$$田中司令$$
「We can now call the northern $$中央大陸$$ a complete victory for Earth's side.」

384:t_029:4.en:
$$シャア$$
「But the Empire on $$蒼の地球$$ won't simply ignore today's victory.」

384:t_029:6.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$バルビエル$$ has made his move too... The next battle will be even larger.」

384:t_029:7.en:
$$シン$$
「That's just what we want. It's why we came to $$翠の地球$$.」

384:t_029:8.en:
$$万丈$$
「$$オペレーション・エクリプス$$... So we're finally entering the second phase.」

384:t_029:9.en:
$n
(Please wait for us, Miss $$スズネ$$... We'll come to rescue you, no matter what.)

384:t_029:10.en:
$n
(Whatever traps $$バルビエル$$ may have laid...)

384:t_030:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「How ridiculous, $c! By shooting down your comrades, you've proven your own incompetence!」

384:t_030:1.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「Shooting down the resistance has worsened the residents' panic.」

384:t_031:0.en:
$$田中司令$$
「We have successfully disabled the resistance.」

384:t_031:1.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「This is our only option now. Disable the other machines the same way.」

384:t_100:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「Hang on, you guys! I'll rescue you soon!」

384:t_100:1.en:
$$メール$$
「Go, go, Darling! But don't overdo it today!」
